title: Sandwiching yield distributions allows users to profit from redemption
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `StakedYuzuUSD` allows users to deposit and initiate redeem requests immediately after the reward distribution. When rewards are distributed to the `StakedYuzuUSD` contract, the `totalAssets()` increases while `totalSupply()` remains constant, which improve the exchange rate for all shareholders.   However, users can sandwich the reward distribution with the deposit and redeem requests to initiate redemption requests.
